# CreativeLAB.in.th

> CreativeLAB.in.th is a creative content and advertising agency based on Koh Phangan, Thailand. We provide advertising, social media, photography, video production, web design and branding for villas, restaurants, hospitality brands and local businesses on the island.

## Services

### Advertising
https://creativelab.in.th/advertising — Creative advertising on Koh Phangan: paid campaigns, media buying, strategy for island businesses
### Social Media
https://creativelab.in.th/social-media — Social media marketing on Koh Phangan: content, management, growth for island businesses
### Villas & Real Estate
https://creativelab.in.th/villas-real-estate — Villa & real estate marketing on Koh Phangan: photography, video, listings for island properties
### Food & Restaurants
https://creativelab.in.th/food-restaurants — Food & restaurant marketing on Koh Phangan: photography, video, branding for island hospitality
### Business & Local Presence
https://creativelab.in.th/business-local-presence — Local business marketing on Koh Phangan: Google Maps, listings, branding, signage
### Websites & Digital
https://creativelab.in.th/websites-digital — Website design & development on Koh Phangan: custom sites and e-commerce for island businesses
### Video & Production
https://creativelab.in.th/video-production — Video production on Koh Phangan: cinematic, drone, social content for island businesses
### Branding & Creative
https://creativelab.in.th/branding-creative — Branding & creative on Koh Phangan: identity, design, packaging for island businesses
